agentic-dev-environment
panels.description: ONE GraphQL call per panel (4 aliased searches - 8 calls/refresh fleet-wide vs the REST search API's 30/min budget that previously starved the row). State bars are direct positive queries mirroring the stat rows; Unaccounted = Total - sum = issues no state represents (untriaged/no-label etc.). Nonzero Unaccounted is the pain-point signal; negative means states overlap. Never widen a state bar to shrink it.
